description: This file defines a function fetchNewUsersOverTime that retrieves 'new users over time' analytics data from an API endpoint. It imports a client from another module and exports an async function that makes an HTTP GET request with configurable granularity (day, week, or month). It includes error handling and data normalization.

methods.name: fetchNewUsersOverTime(granularity = "day")
methods.description: Fetches 'new users over time' analytics data from the backend with specified granularity.
